help.overview: What actions are and how they relate to Logic
help.shape: Some settings change the structure of the action's graph
help.account: Which streaming account the action listens on and replies with
help.cooldown: How often the action may run, optionally shared with other actions
help.counter: Count how often the action ran and use the number in the reply
help.placeholders: Placeholders you can use in the text

hotkey.label: Hotkey
hotkey.description: Press a key combination to play a clip, set a property, control media…

chat_command.label: Chat command
chat_command.description: Reply to a chat command like !hug, with cooldown, minimum rank and an optional counter

row.resetTip: Rebuild the graph from the template (discards your edits to the graph)

badge.modifiedTip: The graph was edited and differs from what the template generated.
badge.templateUpdateTip: The template now generates a different graph. Reset to use it (discards your edits to the graph).
badge.missingGraphTip: This action has no graph. Reset creates it from the template.

confirm.reset: Rebuild the graph of “{{name}}” from its template? Your edits to the graph are discarded.
confirm.rebuild: This change rebuilds the graph of “{{name}}” and discards your edits to the graph. Continue?

form.name: Name
form.aliasesHint: Other names for the same command, separated by spaces or commas.
form.argsPatternHint: Optional pattern the text after the command must match. Named groups become placeholders.
